name: 🌽Grow It RNG [COSMIC GEAR]
desc:
🌱 Welcome to Grow It RNG!

Plant seeds, roll random crop sizes, harvest MASSIVE fruits, and grow the biggest crop in the server!
Make your farm efficient as possible as pass your friends!

USE CODE 1mvisits FOR $10k!

🌙 NEW: THE MOON — unlock the UFO and farm a whole second world! Moon-only seeds, pets, and totems await.
👆 NEW: CROP CLICK POWER — click your crops to grow them faster. Upgrade it in the Rebirth Shop!

⭐ Roll tiny carrots or gigantic 1 in 1,000,000,000 crops
🌙 Crops keep growing while you're OFFLINE — come back to giants!
🕳️ Find the Secret Cave and unlock the FORBIDDEN SHOP
😈 Steal crops from other farms if you dare
🐾 Catch wild pets that boost your speed and size
💧 Water crops with Sprinklers and More!
👑 Customers bid on your crops — sell to the highest offer
📅 NEW UPDATES EVERY SATURDAY!
👥 +20% cash for every friend in your server!

Events every Friday 6pm EST!

🔥 Like the game and join LoganTaylor Studios for free rewards!
